name: Senna
notes: Opening: Dawning Shadow (R) is cast at t=0 since its 100-140s cooldown far exceeds any fight length, so it is cast once as early as possible; its 1s cast time delays the first basic attack accordingly.
Piercing Darkness (Q) is cast on cooldown; its cooldown is refunded 1s per basic attack landed, but not by Q's own cast, for simplicity.
Last Embrace (W) is cast on cooldown; its damage is treated as landing on cast (travel/attach time not modeled beyond the cast time itself).
Basic attacks are woven continuously throughout the fight.

The Mist mark/consume cycle is modeled as a state machine on the dummy: an unmarked, non-immune target is marked by the next attack or ability hit; a marked target's next hit consumes the mark, dealing the current-health-percent bonus damage, granting a Mist stack, and rendering the target immune to being re-marked for a level-scaled duration; an unconsumed mark expires after 4s. This rate-limits current-health procs and Mist-stack growth independent of attack speed, per the wiki's description.
Mist marks/consumption are assumed to trigger from basic attacks and from Q, W and R hits alike, per Absolution's broad 'basic attacks on-hit and abilities' wording.
The current-health-percent mark-consume damage is capped at 10% of current health from level 10 onward, per the wiki; the kit's byLevel array bakes this cap in directly.

Relic Cannon's on-hit bonus physical damage (20% AD) applies on every basic attack and on every Piercing Darkness cast, since the wiki states Piercing Darkness also applies on-hit effects against champions hit; it is not applied for Last Embrace or Dawning Shadow, which are not stated to apply on-hit effects.

Mist stacks grant permanent bonus AD (0.75/stack), which feeds basic-attack damage and every bonus-AD ability ratio. The crit chance and attack range granted every 20 stacks are not modeled: the engine has no hook to add dynamic crit chance mid-fight, and the crit-to-lifesteal conversion is not modeled since lifesteal/healing is outside the fight's scope.
Starting Mist stacks are assumed to be 0 (no prior kills before the fight begins).
Curse of the Black Mist (E) is never cast: it deals no damage, and its camouflage/movement-speed effects are ignored by a stationary-dummy damage fight.
Mana costs are not modeled: none of Q/W/E/R's costs plausibly bind Senna's mana pool within a 15s fight at level 16.

assumed.why: the raw sheet byLevel array continues linearly past level 10 to 18, but the wiki's pp formula caps the value at 10 from level 10 onward; used the wiki's capped reading as the more common in-game description
